spin.label: Speed
spin.note: Reactivity drives the magnitude; spin_sign/Flip owns the sign (magnitude_only preserves it on write). PORTED 2026-08-20 (STAR's own reverse flares, owner ask: "use the flip control for star"): a FlareKind targeting spin_sign is now translated by scene_response._compute_param_moves into a signed, magnitude-preserving, FORCED-INSTANT write on this key (spin_sign's own note has the mechanism) — before that date this translation was LEGACY-ONLY (services/morph_compiler.py's _sign_control_patch, never ported), so SPECTRA wrote the raw signed value straight to this key instead; fx/effects/radial.py's own CONFIG_SCHEMA accepts spin in [-1.0, 1.0], wider than this registry's declared [0, 1] magnitude-only range. Retagged smooth=true 2026-08-17 (was false): config_updated re-derives self.spin = nonlinear_log(config['spin'], 2) via fx/utils.py on every tween frame, including mid-glide, and nonlinear_log = sign(x)*abs(x)**power is continuous through zero and negative x — verified against source, not merely matching intent. Zero live scene binds spin via signal=random, so this has no effect on _reroll's dice-glide gate; a direct (non-sign_control) ParamTarget patch on spin (scene_response._move_params) still glides or jumps per this smooth tag, unchanged — only a spin_sign-targeted patch is forced instant.

spin_sign.label: Flip
spin_sign.note: On=positive spin, Off=negative spin, Toggle=negate sign. PORTED UNDER SPECTRA 2026-08-20 (STAR's reverse flares — his words, "use the flip control for star", the trade told to him and taken knowingly: no pause, but an instant, more jarring turn). Before this date this was INERT: maps_to/sign_control translation existed only in legacy services/morph_compiler.py/trigger_engine.py, and fx/effects/radial.py's CONFIG_SCHEMA has no spin_sign key at all (a same-named local var in that file's particle-handoff snapshot is unrelated) — a write targeting this key would have landed as an inert extra key in the effect's _config (voluptuous extra=ALLOW_EXTRA passes it through unvalidated) that radial.py never reads, exactly legacy's own morph_compiler.py docstring's "LedFX has no bool to receive, so writing the virtual name would be an inert no-op key." The port keeps that shape rather than adding a real spin_sign config key to radial.py: scene_response._compute_param_moves redirects a spin_sign-targeted ParamTarget onto `spin` itself (this param's `maps_to`) with only its sign changed, magnitude preserved from spin's own current carried value, and forces the write — departure AND release alike — through executor.jump() regardless of spin's own smooth=true tag, so the sign flip never glides through zero (the exact freeze the flip was built to avoid). One real consequence, not a bug: since the write always lands on the SAME `spin` key every other spin-targeting kind (e.g. STAR's own "Flare/Drop patch" kinds) already uses, the two compose by ordinary last-write-wins carry semantics — no separate spin_sign state is tracked anywhere, so there is no second, independently-stale bit that could disagree with spin's own value.

base_rotation.label: Base Speed (rev/s)
base_rotation.note: A QUIET BASE ROTATION FLOOR, added 2026-08-25 (owner ask: "I want there to be some minimum absolute value for the base speed the pattern rotates at"). SCALES COMPLETELY DIFFERENTLY FROM `spin`/Speed and is not interchangeable with it: this value is LINEAR and ABSOLUTE in REVOLUTIONS PER SECOND (0.05 = one turn every 20s, 1.0 = one turn a second), whereas `spin` is a GAIN that fx/effects/radial.py squares before use (nonlinear_log(x,2)/10) and then multiplies by the LIVE captured lows power — so `spin` produces exactly zero rotation in silence at any value, which is the whole reason this param exists (docs/spectra-star-motion-audio-idle.md). SEMANTICS ARE A FLOOR, NOT A SUM: effective rev/s = max(base_rotation, reactive rev/s), so the existing reactivity is byte-unchanged whenever the music's own drive is faster. Advanced on the RENDER clock in radial.py's draw() (via _base_rotation_step), NOT in audio_data_updated — a base term in the audio callback would stall exactly when the audio does. Direction follows sign(spin) (i.e. the spin_sign/Flip machinery), else sign(twist), else clockwise; it never fights the current direction. Default 0.0 = the vendored behaviour, unchanged. fx/VENDOR.md deviation #22.

image_location.label: Dance GIF
image_location.note: LedFX asset path (spotfx/dancer/*.gif). ALWAYS patch together with beat_frames

beat_frames.label: Beat Frames
beat_frames.note: Frame indices that land on beats; comes from the gifsmith manifest

handoff_ease.label: Handoff Ease
handoff_ease.note: Seconds adopted particles wind up to full speed after an orbits->blackhole switch

particle_count.label: Particles
particle_count.note: Count changes animate: removed particles fly off, new ones fly in

jiggle.label: Jiggle
jiggle.note: 0 = clean synced orbits, 1 = independent smooth wander + fully decorrelated reactivity

tether_scatter.label: Tether Scatter
tether_scatter.note: 0 = perfectly equidistant tethers, 1 = fully random ring placement

enter_time.label: Enter Time
enter_time.note: Seconds a new or adopted particle glides into its orbit (fly-ins + blackhole->orbits handoff)

reactivity_scale.label: Reactivity
reactivity_scale.note: Master scale; multiplies speed_jump / speed_jog / brightness_audio / size_audio

color_shift.label: Color Jump
color_shift.note: Nudge +1 on a morph to make colors jump A,B,C -> C,A,B

particle_count.label: Fish
particle_count.note: Number of fish kept alive on the matrix. The charge's school and the lull's rush deliberately exceed it for their own moment only.

horizon_scale.label: Home Ring
horizon_scale.note: Radius of the ring each fish's own home patch sits on; 0 anchors every fish to the centre. Orbits' Tether Radius, re-read as a loose home rather than a hard tether.

orbit_radius.label: Turn Radius
orbit_radius.note: The tight circle a fish traces when it turns around. Nothing can turn a fish faster than this allows, which is what makes an about-face an arc instead of a flip.

blob_size.label: Fish Size
blob_size.note: How big the creature is. The rendered half-WIDTH is this divided by sqrt(Body Length), so a fish covers about the area the Orbits blob of the same size would, stretched into an oval.

spin.label: Current Swirl
spin.note: A steady bias making every fish curve the same way, like a slow current. Orbits' Ring Spin, applied to headings instead of a tether ring.

base_speed.label: Swim Speed
base_speed.note: Field radii crossed per second. Deliberately independent of Turn Radius (see fx/effects/fish.py CRUISE_K).

jiggle.label: Jiggle
jiggle.note: 0 = clean synced orbits, 1 = independent smooth wander + fully decorrelated reactivity

tether_scatter.label: Home Scatter
tether_scatter.note: 0 = home patches perfectly equidistant around the ring, 1 = fully random placement.

enter_time.label: Enter Time
enter_time.note: Seconds a new or adopted fish takes to fade in. Unlike Orbits it does not set the arrival PATH - a fish swims in under its own kinematics.

reactivity_scale.label: Reactivity
reactivity_scale.note: Master scale; multiplies speed_jump / speed_jog / brightness_audio / size_audio

trail_decay.label: Wake Length
trail_decay.note: How long the water holds a fish's own smear. The ripple wake has its own life (Ripple Life) and is not affected.

color_shift.label: Color Jump
color_shift.note: Nudge +1 on a morph to make colors jump A,B,C -> C,A,B

body_aspect.label: Body Length
body_aspect.note: Length as a multiple of width - higher is a thinner, longer fish. 1.0 is an Orbits blob.

flap_amount.label: Tail Flap
flap_amount.note: How far the spine throws its tail.

flap_rate.label: Flap Rate
flap_rate.note: Tail beats per second at cruise; it rises with speed. Also sets how often the wake ripples.

flap_accel.label: Flap Accel
flap_accel.note: How much harder the tail waves under acceleration (and softer when slowing).

ripple_amount.label: Ripple Wake
ripple_amount.note: Wake strength. Always subtle relative to the fish; stronger the faster it swims.

ripple_spread.label: Ripple Spread
ripple_spread.note: How fast a ripple opens out, as a multiple of swim speed. Capped so the wake stays fish-sized.

ripple_life.label: Ripple Life
ripple_life.note: Seconds a ripple takes to fade.

avoid_strength.label: Avoid Each Other
avoid_strength.note: How hard they avoid each other. Steering only - it adds one more pull to the desired heading and is bounded by the same turn-rate clamp as every other steer, so it can never reverse a fish on the spot or move one. The dodging distance is DERIVED from body length, not a second knob. 0 = they swim straight through, byte-identical to before. Off during the charge's school and the lull's rush by design.

roam_scale.label: Pond Size
roam_scale.note: How much of the panel the fish use before turning back. 1.0 is the panel's own inscribed ellipse, which on the crystal hex sits inside the lit silhouette.

school_count.label: School Size
school_count.note: Fish that swim in for a CHARGE. Exceeds the population cap for that moment only.

school_variation.label: School Variation
school_variation.note: How much each fish in the school differs from the shared heading - his 'minor variation', never lockstep.

turn_min_time.label: School Turn Gap
turn_min_time.note: Minimum seconds between the school's beat-driven direction changes (his 400ms floor).

rush_count.label: Rush Size
rush_count.note: Fish in the LULL's rush. Exceeds the population cap for that moment only.

rush_time.label: Rush Time
rush_time.note: Seconds the lull's rush takes to sweep past.

rush_chaos.label: Rush Chaos
rush_chaos.note: How disorderly the rush is: 0 = a clean shoal, 1 = scattered.

radius_scale.label: Field Radius
radius_scale.note: Sample-ring radius: where along the fall blobs peak

x_offset.label: X Offset
x_offset.note: Rotates the whole pattern around the strip

approach_width.label: Approach Width
approach_width.note: Radial width of the approach/pass/trail brightness envelope

particle_count.label: Particles
particle_count.note: Count changes animate: removed particles fade out, new ones explode in

x_offset.label: X Offset
x_offset.note: Rotates the whole tether ring around the strip

orbit_radius.label: Orbit Radius
orbit_radius.note: Oscillation reach as a fraction of particle spacing

jiggle.label: Jiggle
jiggle.note: 0 = clean synced orbits, 1 = independent smooth wander + fully decorrelated reactivity

tether_scatter.label: Tether Scatter
tether_scatter.note: 0 = perfectly equidistant tethers, 1 = fully random ring placement

reactivity_scale.label: Reactivity
reactivity_scale.note: Master scale; multiplies speed_jump / speed_jog / brightness_audio / size_audio

speed_jog.label: Jog Reverse Chance
speed_jog.note: Chance per spike/beat that the speed jump runs backward (jiggle correlates the rolls)

color_shift.label: Color Jump
color_shift.note: Nudge +1 on a morph to make colors jump A,B,C -> C,A,B

overlap_blend.label: Overlap Blend
overlap_blend.note: Overlapping blobs: 0 = no brightness gain (hue midpoint), 1 = fully additive

bounce_chance.label: Bounce Chance
bounce_chance.note: Chance per spike/beat that a particle bounces and travels backward along the strip

implode_fade.label: Implode Fade
implode_fade.note: Seconds an add-implosion takes: fragments converge while the particle fades in

implode_reach.label: Implode Reach
implode_reach.note: Fraction of the strip away the implosion fragments start

trail_decay.label: Trail Length
trail_decay.note: Forward: comet-trail length. Reverse: how faint and gradual the imploding burst STARTS (its end is always a fast wink-out)

spawn_rate.label: Spawn Rate
spawn_rate.note: Fireworks launched per second; 0 = beat bursts only

beat_burst.label: Beat Burst
beat_burst.note: Extra fireworks launched on each beat

spawn_audio.label: Audio Spawn
spawn_audio.note: How much the chosen band boosts the launch rate

burst_size.label: Burst Size
burst_size.note: Particles per firework; the shared Edge / particle count shape sub-field lands here on fireworks

burst_speed.label: Burst Speed
burst_speed.note: Base explosion speed in radii per second

burst_life.label: Burst Life
burst_life.note: Seconds a particle lives after the explosion

speed_audio.label: Audio Speed
speed_audio.note: How much the music boosts the explosion speed

brightness_audio.label: Audio Brightness
brightness_audio.note: How much the music pumps firework brightness

drag.label: Drag

gradient.label: Gradient

reverse.label: Reverse

burst_audio.label: Audio Burst Size
burst_audio.note: How much volume grows each firework's particle count; 0 pins it at Burst Size

trail_decay.label: Trail Length
trail_decay.note: Forward: comet-trail length. Reverse: how faint and gradual the imploding burst STARTS (its end is always a fast wink-out)

spawn_rate.label: Spawn Rate
spawn_rate.note: Fireworks (particle pairs) launched per second; 0 = beat bursts only

beat_burst.label: Beat Burst
beat_burst.note: Extra fireworks launched on each beat

spawn_audio.label: Audio Spawn
spawn_audio.note: How much the chosen band boosts the launch rate

burst_speed.label: Burst Speed
burst_speed.note: Base separation speed as a fraction of the strip per second

burst_life.label: Burst Life
burst_life.note: Seconds a particle lives after the launch

speed_audio.label: Audio Speed
speed_audio.note: How much the music boosts the separation speed

brightness_audio.label: Audio Brightness
brightness_audio.note: How much the music pumps firework brightness

drag.label: Drag
drag.note: How hard particles decelerate after the launch

gradient.label: Gradient

reverse.label: Reverse

reverse.label: Reverse

smooth_motion.label: Smooth Motion
smooth_motion.note: Entities glide between positions (beat jumps/recoils ease); game logic unchanged

blob_size.label: Blob Size
blob_size.note: Chain thickness — shares the family Blob Size sub-field

horizontal_gap.label: Horizontal Gap
horizontal_gap.note: Degrees headings must stay away from horizontal

reverse.label: Reverse
reverse.note: Every chain turns around and retraces its path; new chains keep entering from the edge

gradient.label: Gradient
gradient.note: Body + burst colors; the dancers sit 120° either side of the gradient center, bursts grab one random third of it

accent_color.label: Third Color
accent_color.note: Stunt flashes; near-black (the default) colors them from the gradient instead

dance_type.label: Dance Type
dance_type.note: Changing it blends into the new dance at the next beat — never cuts

reverse.label: Partner
reverse.note: Adds the second dancer (same Reverse morph sub-field as the particle family): Neo drop-in / catch entrances, superman / spin-off exits

rotation.label: Stage Angle
rotation.note: Degrees; 20°+ deltas somersault the dancers. Morphable via the shared Twist shape sub-field (absolute or nudge — nudge lo/hi/wrap supported)

trail_decay.label: Trail Length
trail_decay.note: How much trail the dancers leave and how slowly it fades (same lines as the particle effects)

burst_threshold.label: Burst Threshold
burst_threshold.note: Music level a beat needs to fire a flame burst; 0 = every beat

burst_size.label: Burst Size
burst_size.note: Flame particles per burst; the shared Edge / particle count shape sub-field lands here on dancer

burst_audio.label: Burst Audio
burst_audio.note: How much loudness grows the bursts

jiggle.label: Jiggle
jiggle.note: Humanize: random variation added to the moves

base_speed.label: Dance Speed
base_speed.note: Steady dance rate; beats surge the dance forward on top of it (louder hits = bigger flourish surges)

dance_intensity.label: Dance Intensity
dance_intensity.note: How hard they dance: scales beat surges + groove sway + pose exaggeration together

iris_size.label: Iris Size
iris_size.note: Iris radius as a fraction of the panel; the shared Field Radius (radius_scale) shape sub-field lands here

pupil_size.label: Pupil Size
pupil_size.note: Shared Blob Size shape sub-field lands here

gaze_radius.label: Gaze Radius
gaze_radius.note: Radius of the 8-position ring the eye looks around

gaze_depth.label: Gaze Depth
gaze_depth.note: 3D eyeball illusion: iris foreshortens + pupil leads toward the gaze; 0 = flat googly eye

spin.label: Spin
spin.note: Iris rotation (rev/s); sign sets direction, music speeds it up

flames.label: Flames
flames.note: Flame amount from the iris rim; shape-flare target — bump with fallback_s and it burns back down

flame_audio.label: Flame Audio
flame_audio.note: How much music boosts flame intensity and randomness

drift_speed.label: Drift Speed
drift_speed.note: Base gaze search speed; music multiplies it

speed_audio.label: Audio Speed
speed_audio.note: How much the band boosts the gaze search speed

spin_audio.label: Spin Audio
spin_audio.note: How much the band speeds up the iris spin; 0 = constant spin

snap_threshold.label: Snap Threshold
snap_threshold.note: Impulse a beat needs to snap the gaze to a new ring position; 0 = every beat

snap_hold.label: Snap Hold
snap_hold.note: Base seconds the gaze holds after a snap (bigger hits hold longer)

gradient.label: Gradient
gradient.note: Iris color wheel + flame colors; rotates at Spin
